description: This file defines several Orleans grain interfaces and classes related to storage facets, including various implementations for storage factories and default storage configurations. It includes grain interfaces like IStorageFacetGrain, IStorageFactoryGrain, IStorageDefaultFactoryGrain, and their corresponding classes implementing storage behavior with dependency injection of storage services.

classes.name: StorageFacetGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageFacetGrain, provides methods to get storage names and extended info for its storage dependencies.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns the names of the storage instances.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns extended information from the storage instances.

classes.name: StorageFactoryGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageFactoryGrain, creates storage instances via an external factory and retrieves their information.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns the names of the storage instances.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns extended information for the storage instances.

classes.name: StorageDefaultFactoryGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageDefaultFactoryGrain, creates storage instances via a default factory and retrieves their information.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns extended info of storage instances.

classes.name: StorageDefaultFacetGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageDefaultFacetGrain, uses dependency injection with optional state names to initialize storage instances.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns the names of the storage instances.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Provides extended info from the storage instances.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Fetches an array of storage names from the grain's storage dependencies.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Fetches an array of extended info strings from the storage dependencies.
